name: Enrolar pergaminho
description: O pergaminho retorna suavemente à forma enrolada.
context: Fechamento da modal do pergaminho e retorno à estante.
prompt: An ancient thick dry parchment scroll being gently rolled back into a compact cylindrical shape. Soft layered parchment friction, subtle natural creaking and delicate wooden roller movement. One continuous closing motion, gradually tightening into a roll with a quiet natural finish. Close-up realistic Foley, elegant and restrained. No tearing, no crumpling, no music, no voices, no background noise.
observations: A animação parchment-roll-up dura 0,48 s; a API exige pelo menos 0,5 s quando a duração é definida.
